Home / People / Michael Godfrey Portfolio Manager Michael Godfrey Michael joined Hosking Partners as a global generalist portfolio manager in 2026, bringing the shared investment DNA of a genuine capital cycle investor. Michael spent nine years at Marathon Asset Management as a global emerging markets fund manager, joining in 2012 shortly after Jeremy and the global team left to establish Hosking Partners. He subsequently spent time at Lansdowne Partners and Genesis Investment Management as an emerging markets portfolio manager. He began his career as a global equity investor at M&G Investments.
